# TabInteractionType

`Flare.Components.TabInteractionType`

The kind of tab interaction reported to FlareTabs.OnPreviewInteraction.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Activate` | `0` | The user is about to activate (switch to) a tab. |
| `Close` | `1` | The user is about to close a closeable tab. |
